description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaPipelineModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC layer. It includes class declarations for the service interface and its factory, along with methods for client connection management.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the media pipeline module service, including methods for client connection management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineModuleService, given a media pipeline service reference.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client connects to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client disconnects from the IPC service.
